description: Lab Quality Gate registry for CyberNet Lab. Quarantined labs are excluded from normal learner-facing lab listing and cannot be started as regular learner sessions. Source definitions are preserved for future rebuilding.

statuses.VALID: Learner-safe lab. Reference labs and fully validated labs.
statuses.BROKEN: Quarantined lab. Not served as a normal learner lab. Preserved for future rebuild.
statuses.LEGACY: Legacy-format lab. Not automatically quarantined. Available according to existing project behavior pending review.

quarantined.reason: Title/content mismatch: lab claims to teach device naming and banner configuration but steps configure SSH
quarantined.remediationSummary: Lab content corrected. Title changed from 'Network Device Naming and Banner' to 'SSH Hardening and Secure Access'. Category changed from SSH to Security. All 8 legacy steps replaced with 7 canonical steps covering hostname configuration, RSA key generation, local user creation, VTY line restriction to SSH, and SSH connectivity testing. Topology, initialState, troubleshooting, and knowledge check added.
quarantined.notes: Original content configured SSH but was titled as device naming and banner. Remediated to match actual SSH hardening concept with complete canonical lab structure.

quarantined.reason: Title/content mismatch: lab claims to teach trunk port configuration but steps configure access ports/VLANs
quarantined.remediationSummary: Lab content corrected. Retained original title and category. All 9 identical legacy trunk steps replaced with 7 canonical progressive steps covering VLAN creation, trunk configuration on both switches, native VLAN and allowed VLAN setup, trunk verification, and VLAN isolation testing. Topology, initialState, troubleshooting, and knowledge check added.
quarantined.notes: Phase 6.3 re-audit found original quarantine reason inaccurate: actual steps DID configure trunk ports. Remediation adds complete topology, progressive steps, verification, and troubleshooting. Lab now accessible via API.

quarantined.reason: Title/content mismatch: lab claims to teach inter-VLAN routing with router but steps do not configure router subinterfaces or routing
quarantined.remediationSummary: Lab content corrected. Title retained as 'VLAN Lab: Inter-VLAN Routing with Router'. Structured topology and initialState added. Existing subinterface configuration steps preserved. Note: lab uses multiple physical router interfaces rather than subinterfaces due to simulator constraints.
quarantined.notes: Original quarantine reason was inaccurate: steps DID configure subinterfaces. Remediated by adding missing topology and initialState to support runtime execution.

quarantined.notes: Original title mismatched actual ACL content. Remediated to match content with complete canonical lab structure.

quarantined.reason: Title/content mismatch: lab claims to teach router-on-a-stick inter-VLAN routing but steps configure subinterfaces without verification or routing
quarantined.remediationSummary: Lab content corrected. Title changed to 'Inter-VLAN Routing with Router'. All 8 identical legacy subinterface steps replaced with 8 canonical progressive steps covering VLAN creation, access port assignment, router interface configuration, PC IP assignment, intra-VLAN ping, inter-VLAN ping, and routing table verification. Topology, initialState, troubleshooting, and knowledge check added. Note: subinterface encapsulation not simulated; lab uses multiple physical router interfaces.
quarantined.notes: Original content had only identical subinterface configuration steps with no switch-side configuration, PC configuration, or verification. Remediated to complete inter-VLAN routing lab with supported simulator commands. Lab now accessible via API.
